sanskrit: gobhiṣ ṭvā pātv ṛṣabho vṛṣā tvā pātu vājibhiḥ | vāyuṣ ṭvā brahmaṇā pātv indras tvā pātv indriyaiḥ ||
english: May the bull guard thee with cattle; may the stallion guard thee with prizes of victory. May Vāyu guard thee with sacred formulas; may Indra guard thee with powers of might.

sanskrit: somas tvā pātv oṣadhībhir nakṣatraiḥ pātu sūryaḥ | mādbhiṣ ṭvā candro vṛtrahā vātaḥ prāṇena rakṣatu ||
english: May Soma guard thee with healing herbs; may the Sun guard thee with the lunar mansions. May the Moon guard thee with exhilarating draughts; may Vāta, the slayer of Vṛtra, protect thee with vital breath.

sanskrit: tisro divas tisraḥ pṛthivīs trīṇy antarikṣāṇi caturaḥ samudrān | trivṛtaṃ stomaṃ trivṛta āpa āhus tās tvā rakṣantu trivṛtā trivṛdbhiḥ ||
english: Three heavens, three earths, three atmospheres, four oceans — the waters call the threefold hymn-of-praise threefold; may they guard thee, threefold, with their threefold [powers].

sanskrit: trīn nākāṃs trīn samudrāṃs trīn bradhnāṃs trīn vaiṣṭapān | trīn mātariśvanas trīn sūryān goptṝn kalpayāmi te ||
english: Three vault-heavens, three oceans, three radiant [solar orbs], three [vault-dwelling] supporters; three Mātariśvans, three Suns — these guardians I arrange for thee.

sanskrit: ghṛtena tvā sam ukṣāmy agna ājyena vardhayan | agneś candrasya sūryasya mā prāṇaṃ māyino dabhan ||
english: With ghee I anoint thee thoroughly, O Agni, increasing thee with clarified butter. May the deceivers not harm the vital breath of Agni, of the Moon, of the Sun.

sanskrit: mā vaḥ prāṇaṃ mā vo 'pānaṃ mā haro māyino dabhan | bhrājanto viśvavedaso devā daivyena māvata ||
english: May deceivers not harm your in-breath, not your out-breath, not [your] vital heat. You brilliant gods, all-knowing ones, protect me with your divine [power].

sanskrit: prāṇenāgniṃ saṃ dadhati vātaḥ prāṇena saṃhitaḥ | prāṇena viśvatomukhaṃ sūryaṃ devā ajanayan ||
english: With vital breath they unite Agni; Vāta is held together by vital breath. With vital breath the gods generated the Sun, who faces all directions.

sanskrit: āyuṣāyuṣkṛtāṃ jīva- -āyuṣmāṃ jīva mā mṛthāḥ | prāṇenātmanvatāṃ jīva mā mṛtyor upa gā vaśam ||
english: Live with the life-span of those who have made long life; live long, do not die. Live by the vital breath of those endowed with self; do not come under the sway of Death.

sanskrit: devānāṃ nihitaṃ nidhiṃ yam indrānvavindan pathibhir devayānaiḥ | āpo hiraṇyaṃ jugupus trivṛdbhis tās tvā rakṣantu trivṛtā trivṛdbhiḥ ||
english: The treasure laid away by the gods, which Indra found by the god-traveled paths — the waters guarded the gold with their threefold [power]; may they guard thee, threefold, with their threefold [powers].

sanskrit: trayastriṃśad devatās trīṇi ca vīryāṇi priyāyamāṇā jugupur apsv antaḥ | asmiṃś candre adhi yad dhiraṇyaṃ tenāyaṃ kṛṇavad vīryāṇi ||
english: The thirty-three deities, along with three heroic powers, took delight and guarded [them] within the waters. Whatever gold rests upon this Moon — by that may this one accomplish heroic deeds.

sanskrit: ye devā divy ekādaśa stha te devāso havir idaṃ juṣadhvam ||
english: You gods who are eleven in heaven — you divine ones, take pleasure in this oblation.

sanskrit: ye devā antarikṣa ekādaśa stha (…) ||
english: You gods who are eleven in the atmosphere — [take pleasure in this oblation].

sanskrit: ye devāḥ pṛthivyām ekādaśa stha te devāso havir idaṃ juṣadhvam ||
english: You gods who are eleven on the earth — you divine ones, take pleasure in this oblation.

sanskrit: asapatnaṃ purastāt paścān no 'bhayaṃ kṛtam | savitā mā dakṣiṇata uttarān mā śacīpatiḥ ||
english: Free of rivals before us; behind us fearlessness has been made. May Savitṛ [guard] me from the south; from the north may Śacī's lord [guard me].

sanskrit: divo mādityā rakṣantu bhūmyā rakṣantv agnayaḥ | indrāgnī rakṣatāṃ mā purastād aśvināv abhitaḥ śarma yacchatām | tiraścīn aghnyā rakṣatu jātavedā bhūtakṛto me sarvataḥ santu varma ||
english: May the Ādityas protect me from the sky; may the fires protect me from the earth. May Indra and Agni protect me from the front; may the Aśvins grant me shelter on both sides. May Jātavedas protect me from the oblique [directions]; may those who created beings be my armor on all sides.

sanskrit: ye 'psv antar agnayaḥ praviṣṭā mroko manohā khano nirdāha ātmadūṣis tanadūṣiḥ | idaṃ tān ati sṛjāmi nir eno nir anṛtaṃ sṛjāmi ||
english: Those fires that have entered into the waters — the scalding [fever], the mind-slayer, the excavating [pain], the consuming [fire], the defiler of the self, the defiler of the body — these I now drive away. I expel sin; I expel falsehood.

sanskrit: abhūtyā satvāya nir duṣvapnyaṃ sṛjāmi | vasiṣṭhārundhatī mā pātāṃ prajāpateḥ prastaro bṛhaspateḥ keśāḥ ||
english: From [the power of] non-being and of evil being, I expel evil dreaming. May Vasiṣṭha and Arundhatī protect me; may the litter-grass of Prajāpati [and] the hair-locks of Bṛhaspati [guard me].

sanskrit: adabdhaṃ cakṣuḥ suśrutau karṇāv akṣitau me prāṇāpānau | hṛdayā jarasaṃ mā mā hāsīr madhya mā riṣam ||
english: An undimmed eye; well-hearing ears; my in-breath and out-breath unimpaired. May my heart not forsake old age for me; may I suffer no harm in my midst.

sanskrit: āpo mā śundhantu duṣkṛtād duritā yāni cakṛma | ayāma śuddhā uditas tanūbhiḥ ||
english: May the waters cleanse me from wrong-doing, from the misdeeds we have committed. May we go forth purified, risen up, with our bodies [restored].

sanskrit: vaiśvānaro raśmibhir naḥ punātu vātaḥ prāṇeneṣiro namobhiḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī payasā payasvatī ṛtāvarī yajñiye mā punītām ||
english: May Vaiśvānara purify us with his rays; may Vāta, the swift one, [purify us] with vital breath and with reverences. May Heaven-and-Earth, abounding in milk, upholding cosmic order, worthy of sacrifice, purify me.

sanskrit: punantu māgnayo gārhapatyāḥ punantu mā dhṛṣṇyā devahūtāḥ | punantu mā śakvarīḥ somapṛṣṭhāḥ pavamānāso ajriṇaḥ ||
english: May the Gārhapatya fires purify me; may the bold, god-summoning [fires] purify me. May the Śakvarī verses, borne on Soma's back, the purifying [streams], the swift ones, purify me.

sanskrit: yaḥ potā sa punātu mā bṛhadbhir deva savitaḥ | varṣiṣṭhair dyām ivopari ||
english: Let him who is the Potṛ [priest] purify me, O god Savitṛ, with the great and loftiest [rites], even as [he purifies] the sky above.

sanskrit: brahmasavaiḥ punātu mā rājasavaiḥ punātu mā | śataṃ pavitrā vitatā tiraścā tebhir mā devaḥ savitā punātu ||
english: May [Savitṛ] purify me with brahman-pressings; may he purify me with kingly pressings. A hundred purifying [filters] are spread out obliquely — with those may the god Savitṛ purify me.

sanskrit: śataṃ ca mā pavitāraḥ punantu sahasraṃ ca prasravaṇeṣv āpaḥ | āpa iva pūto 'smy agnir iva suvarcāḥ sūrya iva sucakṣāḥ ||
english: May a hundred purifiers cleanse me, and a thousand waters at the flowing streams. I am purified as the waters [are pure], bright as Agni, clear-sighted as the Sun.

sanskrit: urūṇasāv asutṛpā udumbalau yamasya dūtau carato janām̐ anu | tāv asmabhyaṃ dṛśaye sūryāya punar dātām asum adyeha bhadram ||
english: Those two wide-nostriled, life-drinking, Udumbara-hued messengers of Yama roam among the people — may those two grant back to us, for sight of the Sun, our vital breath here today, [bestowing] the auspicious.
